title: 3 Dark Crunchyroll Anime to Watch After Jaadugar’s Finale
content: Since the Fall 2026 anime season is almost here , the Summer series are all ending one by one. The Summer lineup has been the biggest quarter of the year for new debuts, including Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You, Chainsmoker Cat , and more.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Hottest New Shonen Anime of 2026 Has the Perfect Ending and Sparks an Industry Change
content: As the Summer 2026 anime season is about to come to an end, many of the anime currently airing on the leading streaming platform, Crunchyroll , are also nearing their finales. Several anime have already come to an end, including what could be the Anime of the Year this year.
author: ComicBook

title: Major Crunchyroll Isekai Reveals New Look Ahead of Season 2 Premiere This Fall
content: A major Isekai hidden gem is coming back for a new season of episodes with Crunchyroll this Fall, and has revealed a new look before its big premiere. The Fall 2026 anime schedule is fast approaching, and in many ways some of these new shows are going to be making their debuts much sooner than others.
author: ComicBook

title: Solo Leveling to Continue Jinwoo’s Story With Its Coolest Release Yet – Watch Trailer
content: Solo Leveling is finally set to shed light on a missing part of Sung Jinwoo’s story from the original webcomics releases, and a new game is going to show off all the action fans had never seen before.
author: ComicBook

title: For Only the Fifth Time in 29 Years, South Park Makes Big Change to Theme Song
content: South Park has made a big change to its opening theme song for Season 29, and it’s only the fifth time that the regular theme song has been changed in such a way in 29 long years of the series.
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Years Later, Major Crunchyroll Anime Finally Confirms Season 2 Release – Watch Trailer
content: Three years after a major anime series made its original debut streaming with Crunchyroll , one romance series has finally confirmed its Season 2 release plans after being hit by a surprise delay behind the scenes.

title: Tokyo Game Show 2026 Draws 257,642 Attendees
content: Tokyo Game Show 2026 reported an in-person attendance of 257,642 over the course of four days (September 17-20). The number is a slight decrease from last year's in-person attendance of 263,101 attendees.
author: ANN

title: 'Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga' Second Part Announced for Winter 2027
content: The 11th and final episode of Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den ( Though I Am an Inept Villainess ) ended with an announcement on Monday that a second part, titled Hajimete no Gaiyuu-hen , is in production.
author: MyAnimeList
